title: Q-GAP-executor-merged-pr: Executor opens and merges its own pull request
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** grep:ops/executor-log.jsonl::"result": "pr-merged"
**Status:** done
**Evidence:** ops/executor-log.jsonl has pr-merged rows for pull requests 749 (merge commit 970134c) and 762 (merge commit cd2e26a), both opened by the executor on 2026-11-20; both are mechanical fixes.

Gap in component `code-repo`: Executor opens and merges its own pull request. The executor opens pull requests with real models (five by 2026-11-20: four closed without merging, one open); none has merged yet. The log on main records each outcome (`python3 -m foundation executor --fold`, PR-OUTCOME-1), and this item closes itself on the first `pr-merged` row. Source: doctrine/market.json (MARKET-1).
